mapper.select: SELECT id, node_id, next_node_id, label, condition_expr, sort_order, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM scenario_node_option WHERE node_id = #{nodeId} ORDER BY sort_order, id
SELECT id, node_id, next_node_id, label, condition_expr, sort_order, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM scenario_node_option WHERE node_id = #{nodeId} AND enabled = TRUE ORDER BY sort_order, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scenario_node_option (node_id, next_node_id, label, condition_expr, sort_order, enabled) VALUES (#{nodeId}, #{nextNodeId}, #{label}, #{conditionExpr}, #{sortOrder}, #{enabled})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM scenario_node_option WHERE node_id IN (SELECT id FROM scenario_node WHERE version_id = #{versionId})
